name: CrustaceanFactory
caption: A crustacean (lobster/crayfish) rendered as a textured 3D model. The creature lies horizontally with a long segmented abdomen composed of multiple smooth, rounded carapace segments in warm reddish-brown. At the front, two prominent large chelae (claws) — one larger crusher claw with a white-tipped pincer and one slender smaller claw — extend outward. Two long thin antennae rise vertically from the cephalothorax. Several pairs of small walking legs and swimmerets are present underneath the body. The tail fan spreads at the rear. The smooth, slightly glossy exoskeleton has subtle specular highlights.
